# HabitFlow

> HabitFlow is an offline-first Precision Life & Finance OS combining habit tracking, deep work Pomodoro timers, Eisenhower task prioritization, 90-day goal milestones, fitness & nutrition logging, and personal finance management.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://habitflow.tech/): Interactive product overview, habits loop showcase, daily flow simulator, and deep work focus hub.
- [Sign In / Sign Up](https://habitflow.tech/login): Access your synced HabitFlow workspace.
- [Tutorial](https://habitflow.tech/tutorial): Interactive guide to HabitFlow features and workflows.
